2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:name_site and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Gives the site (installation) the address https://<name>.trillion.run/: name, or one made from title.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: undefined (list_files, find_file, read_file, write_file_start, write_file_piece, write_file_finish).
